incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary error-rate spike detected in eu-west-1 canary pool (5m avg) — baseline 2% -> current 18%. Auto-mitigation not triggered (thresholds misaligned). Paging #oncall. incident id: INC-2026-1823
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. pinging @Jon and @Priya. Can we confirm this is a rollout-related regression?
Jon (sre): Looking at traces now. Errors are 500s from model runtime path, stack shows kv-cache invalidation NPE. Canary build tag: r-infer-2026.03.09-canary.
Priya (eng-infra): KV change landed in today's canary rollout. I see a feature flag gate: `feature.kv_cache_v2` enabled for 10% traffic.
Sam (support): Any customer impact so we should open a CS note?
Laura (cust-suc): Notified two paying customers in eu-west-1 already reported timeouts ~09:12UTC. Both on premium tier. No major data loss, but requests failing intermittently.
Maya (oncall): Priority = P1 due to paying customers. Plan: flip the flag to disable v2 for canary, throttle canary traffic to 0, collect logs, then monitor error-rate for 5m. Who can flip the flag?
Priya (eng-infra): I can flip in LaunchDarkly. Flag path: `ld://redwood/feature.kv_cache_v2`. Quick toggle: ```curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $LD_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://app.launchdarkly.com/api/v2/flags/redwood/feature.kv_cache_v2 --data '{"environments":{"production":{"on":false}}}'```
Evan (eng-platform): I'll prepare a rollback plan for canary -> stable model variant (route rewrite). If flag flip doesn't clear it within 3m we'll shift canary traffic to stable backend via route policy `canary->stable-traffic:100%`.
Jon (sre): Collecting stack traces and request ids. Please save any `req_id` shown in customer reports. I'll run a targeted heap dump on one canary host if needed.
Sam (support): I'll send an incident ack to the two customers, short note: "We are investigating elevated errors in eu-west-1 canary. We have paused the canary rollout and will update in 15 minutes." Want approval?
Laura (cust-suc): Go ahead — keep it factual, ETA 15-30m. Add link to status page: <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1823456789>
Priya (eng-infra): Toggling flag now -> `feature.kv_cache_v2 = false` ... ✅ toggled at 09:18:42 UTC.
incident-bot: Action logged: feature flag toggle by Priya at 1823456722. Incident state -> mitigation: flag-flip.
Maya (oncall): Reducing canary traffic to 0% via route policy (Evan, can you take?)
Evan (eng-platform): Executing route change: `rbacctl set-route canary eu-west-1 --to stable --weight 100` -> applied 09:19:10 UTC. Rolling window traffic should cutoff within 30s.
Jon (sre): Watching metrics. Error-rate trending down: 18% -> 6% after flag flip and route change. Still above baseline. Collecting logs for 5 more minutes.
Priya (eng-infra): I'm pulling kernel and runtime logs; saving to internal bucket `s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1823456789/`. Command: `tar czf /tmp/1823456789-logs.tgz /var/log/redwood/* && aws s3 cp /tmp/1823456789-logs.tgz s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1823456789/`
Sam (support): Customers updated: message sent at 09:21 UTC. They asked for a follow-up when fully mitigated.
Laura (cust-suc): Noted. I'll track replies and escalate to account lead if they push.
Maya (oncall): Verification checklist: 1) Error-rate < 2.5% for 10m 2) No 500s in sampled traces 3) Smoke tests green for canary path 4) Confirm customers see recovery. Jon/Priya/Evan own items 1-3. Sam/Laura own 4.
Jon (sre): Error-rate now 1.9% (09:24 UTC). Sampling traces show no recent NPEs.
Priya (eng-infra): Runtime logs show kv-cache v2 calls dropped to zero. Upload complete.
Evan (eng-platform): Smoke tests: run id `smoke-182345` -> all checks PASS (latency within SLO).
Maya (oncall): Good. I'm marking mitigation: success. Next steps: 1) keep stable routing for 1h, 2) roll back the canary build or patch kv invalidation, 3) run postmortem. Anyone want to own the rollback or patch?
Priya (eng-infra): I'll open a PR to revert the KV change and tag for hotfix release. Assigning to `@eng-runtime` for review.
Jon (sre): I'll attach collected traces and a short impact summary to the incident.
Sam (support): I'll schedule the customer follow-up emails after 1h if all clear.
Laura (cust-suc): I'll prepare a CS brief for the account owners.
Maya (oncall): Incident closed as mitigated at 09:32 UTC. Recording closure notes and linking runbook. incident-bot: Creating post-incident ticket INC-2026-1823-PM.
incident-bot: [ACTION] Please fill in root cause, timeline, pg fixes, and customer comms to complete the postmortem template: <https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-1823>
Jon (sre): Adding preliminary root cause: race in kv-cache invalidation when `feature.kv_cache_v2` is enabled under concurrent warm-start. Repro steps in PR.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving follow-ups in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
